promoCode.description: Optional promo code. A problem with it never fails the request; see promoStatus and promoError.

tierId.description: The pass (ticket tier). Always one ticket, for the buyer.

canPlaceOrder.description: Whether this selection would pass the signed-in preview right now. Checks that depend on who the buyer is happen after sign-in. Disable Pay only when this is false.

promoError.description: Set only when promoStatus is `rejected`. Disabled codes, and any code while the event is not on sale, read as PROMO_CODE_NOT_FOUND.

promoStatus.description: `none`: no code sent. `applied`: the code is in the price. `rejected`: priced without it, see promoError. `deferred`: too many codes tried from here; priced without it and nothing said about the code, apply it after sign-in.

details.description: For ADDON_OUT_OF_STOCK: { requested, available }. `available` is null whenever the public add-on catalog would hide the count, and 0 when sold out.

path.description: Indexes this request's `addons` (or `tickets`, `pricing.totalEgp`). The signed-in preview indexes the saved cart instead, so compare issue codes, never paths.

status.description: `unavailable` (lines and promo only) whenever validation, pricing or promo issues exist. A zero total is still `complete`, with ZERO_TOTAL_ORDER_NOT_ALLOWED in issues.

post.description:
Prices one ticket for the buyer, plus extras for that buyer, exactly as the signed-in cart preview (`POST /mobile/carts/{cartId}/preview`) would, without an account or a cart. Nothing is saved, held or claimed, and no pricing confirmation token is issued: the signed-in preview before Pay is authoritative.

Tiers and add-on options the public event page hides are refused. Shared rooms, more than one room and repeated options are refused. A promo problem never fails the request: the price is computed without the code and `promoStatus`/`promoError` say why. No authentication. Browsers must send an `Origin` listed in WEB_CLIENT_ORIGINS; with WEB_CLIENT_ORIGINS unset the route answers 503 to everyone.

parameters.description: Event UUID or slug.
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.description: Ignored. The API always returns English responses.
parameters.name: Accept-Language

200.description: The price, with any issues that would stop the order. Never cached.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR (body or identifier); CART_LINE_PAYLOAD_INVALID (an option twice, quantity out of bounds); CART_EVENT_MISMATCH (tier not in this event or not publicly visible); CART_TICKET_ITEM_NOT_FOUND (the event allows no tickets per order); ADDON_OPTION_NOT_AVAILABLE (option not in this event or not publicly visible); WEB_SHARED_ROOM_NOT_ALLOWED (room occupancy other than 1); PERSON_ALREADY_HAS_ACCOMMODATION (more than one room)

403.description: CHECKOUT_PREVIEW_ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED: the page origin is not in WEB_CLIENT_ORIGINS

409.description: ADDONS_FEATURE_DISABLED: extras sent while add-ons are switched off

429.description: CHECKOUT_PREVIEW_RATE_LIMITED, with retryAfterSeconds and a Retry-After header. The buyer may continue to sign-in; the signed-in preview prices the order.

503.description: CHECKOUT_PREVIEW_NOT_CONFIGURED: WEB_CLIENT_ORIGINS is not set on this environment, so the preview is off

post.summary: Price a web checkout selection without signing in
